_comment: Configuration for the Farm Water Analysis dashboard generator (lib/build_dashboard.py). Edit these values as the garden / irrigation plan changes; no code changes needed.

plan._comment: Actual watering is a fixed timer, not a volume-based/Smart plan (that was never implemented). The WFC01 meters the tomato raised bed line ONLY; peppers run on a separate, unmetered timer. Delivery figures below are the MEASURED metered rate on clean days, not a nameplate estimate — real flow runs well above emitter nameplate.
plan.metered_regime_note: 170 L/day & 1150 L/wk were measured under the prior 14-min run (Jul 16–22). At 10 min expect ~10/14 of that: ~120 L/day, ~820 L/wk once new exports land.

schedule_log.change: Tomato timer set: 14 min once daily @ 05:05 PT (fixed-timer, replacing earlier irregular hand-timing).
Tomato timer trimmed 14 → 10 min to cut leaching / deep percolation; watch the overnight probe min holds near 58–60% at 3 in.
